constructor-arg.value: INSERT INTO pipeline.capacity_block_extension ( reservation_id, origin_id, extension_offering_id, duration_hours, upfront_fee_amount, upfront_fee_currency, status, status_reason, requested_by, created, updated, start_date, end_date ) VALUES ( :RESERVATION_ID, :ORIGIN_ID, :EXTENSION_OFFERING_ID, :DURATION_HOURS, :UPFRONT_FEE_AMOUNT, :UPFRONT_FEE_CURRENCY, :STATUS, :STATUS_REASON, :REQUESTED_BY, :CREATED, :UPDATED, :START_DATE, :END_DATE)

UPDATE pipeline.capacity_block_extension SET duration_hours = :DURATION_HOURS, status = :STATUS, status_reason = :STATUS_REASON, updated = :UPDATED, start_date = :START_DATE, end_date = :END_DATE WHERE id = :ID

SELECT e.id AS ID, e.reservation_id AS RESERVATION_ID, e.origin_id AS ORIGIN_ID, e.extension_offering_id AS EXTENSION_OFFERING_ID, e.duration_hours AS DURATION_HOURS, e.upfront_fee_amount AS UPFRONT_FEE_AMOUNT, e.upfront_fee_currency AS UPFRONT_FEE_CURRENCY, e.status AS STATUS, e.status_reason AS STATUS_REASON, e.requested_by AS REQUESTED_BY, e.created AS CREATED, e.updated AS UPDATED, e.start_date AS START_DATE, e.end_date AS END_DATE FROM pipeline.capacity_block_extension AS e WHERE e.id = ?

SELECT e.id AS ID, e.reservation_id AS RESERVATION_ID, e.origin_id AS ORIGIN_ID, e.extension_offering_id AS EXTENSION_OFFERING_ID, e.duration_hours AS DURATION_HOURS, e.upfront_fee_amount AS UPFRONT_FEE_AMOUNT, e.upfront_fee_currency AS UPFRONT_FEE_CURRENCY, e.status AS STATUS, e.status_reason AS STATUS_REASON, e.requested_by AS REQUESTED_BY, e.created AS CREATED, e.updated AS UPDATED, e.start_date AS START_DATE, e.end_date AS END_DATE FROM pipeline.capacity_block_extension AS e WHERE e.reservation_id = ? ORDER BY e.id
